acquisition_mode.description: How this project supplies its sources, declared so it can be verified instead of inferred. 'extract' acquires from Access binaries, 'export' from already-exported source trees, 'mixed' from both. Acquisition checks the declaration against how the artifacts actually route and refuses a manifest that contradicts itself.

runtime.description: Per-artifact runtime choices passed to the adapter that acquires it. Declared here because they were previously discoverable only by reading adapter source, while skip_object_export in particular decides whether the run needs an Access host at all.

skip_object_export.description: Acquire through the DAO tier only. Schema, queries and the object-name inventory are still collected, but no Access host is started - so no AutoExec, no VBA project load, no modal dialog, and no elevation requirement. Object definition text is not exported.

skip_object_inventory.description: Do not register objects the extractor sees. Use when the same objects already arrive through an imported export package and would otherwise be counted twice.

visible_host.description: Run the Access host visibly so an operator can dismiss dialogs. Makes the run attended and therefore not reproducible unattended; the extractor records a warning saying so.

allow_run_as_invoker.description: Set __COMPAT_LAYER=RunAsInvoker on the PowerShell host. It cannot suppress elevation for the Access COM server, which is launched out of process and does not inherit the variable.

skip_runtime_check.description: Skip Access runtime discovery and use the default PowerShell host.

dao_progid.description: Override the DAO engine ProgID (default DAO.DBEngine.36).

powershell.description: Pin the PowerShell host that drives the Access COM adapter.

password_env.description: Environment variable holding the database password. The password is never written to the command line.

timeout.description: Seconds before the adapter treats the run as hung and terminates the Access host it started.
